== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Lt. Pol Treidum (Japanese)|Lt. Pol Treidum]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160005373/Q1zQHO2Sr0ad4N1DWpgQpg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 93071757.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>cbc67e7cff1d5e013a6686566ba6cdbaea048a2da792b01601c8f9ffbe6acb0f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
